overview_description.description: Sarvam AI develops artificial intelligence infrastructure, models, and applications designed to support Indian languages and enterprise use cases. Its platform provides capabilities such as text-to-speech, speech-to-text, translation, document digitization, dubbing, and conversational AI through APIs and deployable products. The company builds and operates a full-stack AI ecosystem that includes foundational models, application-layer tools, and infrastructure for serving AI workloads at scale. Sarvam’s offerings are used by enterprises, government organizations, and developers to automate workflows, process multilingual content, and enable AI-powered interactions across diverse linguistic contexts. The company also develops language and multimodal models tailored to Indian languages and regional requirements, with support for deployment in cloud, private cloud, on-premises, and air-gapped environments.

about_short_description.short_description: Sarvam AI develops AI infrastructure, models, and applications designed to support Indian languages and enterprise use cases.

product.name: Sarvam 1
product.description: A 2-billion parameter large language model optimized for 10 major Indian languages and English, designed for efficient and accurate Indic language processing and reasoning tasks.

product.name: Sarvam-M
product.description: A 24-billion parameter hybrid Indic large language model fine-tuned for Indian languages, math, and programming tasks with inference optimizations and knowledge base augmentation.

product.name: Sarvam Samvaad
product.description: A voice-enabled, multilingual conversational AI platform supporting 10 Indian languages for deployment via telephone, WhatsApp, and in-app agents.

product.name: Bulbul
product.description: A multilingual text-to-speech model offering natural, code-mixed speech synthesis in 11 Indian languages with controllable prosody and domain-specific pronunciation.

product.name: Saaras (ASR-Translate)
product.description: An automatic speech recognition and translation model converting code-mixed Indic speech into English text, supporting multiple Indian languages.

product.name: Sarvam Translate
product.description: A family of text and translation models supporting direct translation, transliteration, and language identification across 22 Indian languages.
